intent: Collect every PR from a paginated API. list(page) returns {items, next}, where next is null on the last page. No other pages should be requested.

issues.description: The termination condition is inverted; a non-final first page ends collection immediately, while a final page requests list(null).
issues.evidence: Use page1={items:[1],next:2}, page2={items:[2],next:null}. The new function returns [1], never requesting page2.

intent: Prepare an unresolved review for a local preview. A job whose publicationAttempted is true has an unknown remote write outcome and must remain blocked until reconciliation. Preview performs no reconciliation.

issues.description: Preview erases publication uncertainty and its recovery barrier.
issues.evidence: preview({status:'blocked',publicationAttempted:true}) yields status previewed and publicationAttempted false despite no remote reconciliation.

intent: auth=browser must use browser credentials even when an API key is inherited. auth=api-key must use a key. No automatic API fallback is allowed.

issues.description: An inherited API key overrides explicit browser authentication.
issues.evidence: route('browser',{API_KEY:'test'},browser) returns 'test' without calling browser, violating the explicit route.

intent: Abort active review computation when a new head appears. Publication may have an uncertain remote write and must complete reconciliation without being aborted by a poll. job.phase is reviewing or publishing.

issues.description: A new head now aborts an in-progress publisher, contrary to the recovery contract.
issues.evidence: For job.phase='publishing' and different head, abort() is now called where the old code left publication running.

intent: Eligible PRs must be open, ready (not draft), and from the same repository. pr.fork is boolean. This is the complete eligibility policy.
Review identity changes when head SHA, base SHA, or policy changes. sha() deterministically hashes a string and policyHash is an opaque string.

issues.description: Changing only the base SHA reuses an old review identity.
issues.evidence: Two PR snapshots with the same head and policy but different bases now hash identical input arrays.

intent: When a provider is paused, make no model calls. call() returns the review promise. Unpaused providers must keep working.

issues.description: A paused provider still starts inference before the guard.
issues.evidence: With paused=true, call() runs before returning {status:'paused'}, consuming allowance or producing a rejected promise.

intent: Source evidence must overlap the cited 1-based source line. A substring elsewhere in the file is insufficient. source is LF text and evidence is a nonempty single-line string.

issues.description: Evidence from an unrelated line now validates a false source anchor.
issues.evidence: valid('safe\nbug','bug',1) returns true after the change and false before it.

intent: Display a PR title as plain Markdown text. Escape mentions so the generated text does not notify users. The function only needs to escape @ characters for this change.
Always release the lock after work completes or throws. release() succeeds; the caller is responsible for acquiring the lock before invoking run(). Preserve work()'s result or rejection.
